title: Should you lie on your resume
description:
We're not telling you to lie....we're telling you to embellish hahah

No actually we're telling you to tailor your resume and using the job description to guide you.

#resumehelp #resumeadvice #resume #resumes
transcript: people telling you to lie on your resume a term you might have heard is called tailoring your resume what people often think this is is just taking the information from the job description and copying it right over to your resume that's not what we're talking about what it actually means is using the information from the job description to guide what experience of yours that you put on your resume as an example for this job right here in the job description it says they're looking for daily content posted to Facebook Instagram and YouTube now something that might seem like it hits that Mark created marketing material for social media platforms but something tailored with look like this produce 10 to 15 pieces of content that's that daily Mark per week for Instagram and YouTube That's the platforms from the job description resulting in 15% Channel growth month over month that's our metric-based impact the job description is a guide use it for your resume that's what's going to land you interviews
